subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions Updated column switch from relative text to full date/time, and should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork PR that implements it?
rationale: The implementation is small, but the visible timestamp format and the existing conflicting fork PR require maintainer UX and ownership intent before automation queues another fix.

options.title: Adopt full date/time
options.body: Proceed with a narrow full timestamp display, using the existing formatter or a fixed YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm helper, and adopt or replace the fork PR.

options.title: Keep relative text
options.body: Close the implementation path and this feature if compact relative Updated values are the intended Sessions list design.

options.title: Defer to a broader table pass
options.body: Keep this as part of a larger Sessions table UX pass if maintainers do not want a one-column change now.

recommendation.title: Adopt full date/time
recommendation.body: Proceed with a narrow full timestamp display, using the existing formatter or a fixed YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm helper, and adopt or replace the fork PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent current-main ownership signal for the Sessions page and Control UI table behavior.
